description: Land Acquisition - Maradana, Colombo D/S Division, Colomo District
categorisation: This gazette content is a Land Acquisition Notice published under the Land Acquisition Act. It specifically declares that certain lands are needed for a public purpose and provides detailed descriptions of the properties to be acquired, including their location, extent, and boundaries. The content is exclusively focused on land and property-related matters, falling squarely within the definition of a Land Gazette (Type 4). While a government minister is named, this is incidental to the primary purpose of the notice, which is the acquisition of land, not a government personnel or structural change.
